patterns_found.visual_evidence: Both sketches show a long single-column content page ending with a distinct centered button-like rectangle near the footer area, matching the reference page's 'Back to top of page' control.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: A button or link should scroll the viewport back to the top of the page. It may be always visible near the footer or additionally appear after scrolling if enhanced.
patterns_found.ambiguities: The sketch does not show whether the control is persistent, only footer-based, or conditionally revealed after scroll.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply a mostly static informational marketing page with hero imagery, rows of simple navigation/action buttons, long text content, and footer links. No menus, forms, tabs, accordions, overlays, or dynamic loading behaviors are visibly indicated. The only clear JavaScript-worthy interaction implied by the layout and reinforced by the reference HTML is a back-to-top control on this long page; otherwise the page can largely be implemented with standard links and static layout in both mobile and desktop views.
